title: Adapter Pattern
description: Allow incompatible interfaces to work together.

data.text: The **Adapter Pattern** allows incompatible interfaces to work together by wrapping an object in an adapter. It converts the interface of a class into another interface clients expect.

data.title: Adapter Pattern
Key Takeaways
points: Useful for integrating with legacy code or third-party libraries
Can be implemented as class or object adapter
data.takeaway: Use Adapter Pattern when you need to use an existing class but its interface doesn't match the one you need.
